description: All RNGs for PopulationStudy Experiment 1. Patient split was drawn once in PopulationStudy/README.md; val pair split and torch/numpy seeds reuse the same integer.
patient_split_method: random.Random(20260817).sample(P1..P9, k=6) for train; remainder hold-out
val_split_method: per train patient: Random(val_split_seed + patient_index).shuffle(100 pairs); take first 10% as val. Val is train-patients only; P3–P5 never enter train or val.
